Gloves of Silent Destruction
Piece:  Gloves
Material:  Cloth (XXLight)
Class palette:  Mage
Quality:  Mythic (rainbow)

Gloves of Silent Destruction is the cloth ninja gloves from items/pal/MageGlovesPAL.gc (PreBuiltWishingWell001). The client sets SoulBound = true. LeatherMythicPAL.gc has a never-live leather name Gauntlets of Silent Destruction.

Rolled name endings: Mythic Suffixes.

Fixed mods on this wishing-well template:

  • AGI, INT
  • Poison resist, Shadow resist
  • +Fire, +Ice
  • Max health, Max mana
